App approval process — sandbox account > Developer Hub > register app > install & test > 'Send to review' > approved apps publish manually (content read via search result)
Public app requirements — OAuth 2.0, mandatory install/uninstall flows, app approval process (content read via search result)

conditions: Free to list but requires building a real OAuth-enabled integration app and passing Pipedrive's app approval process — not a listing-only directory
requirements: A developer sandbox account (free signup) — required to see Developer Hub
A working app implementing OAuth 2.0 (client_id/client_secret come from Developer Hub)
Mandatory pre-defined installation and uninstallation flows must work
Full listing form in Developer Hub (seven tabs: basic info, OAuth scopes, listing content, support/legal info, etc.)
App must pass the Marketplace team's approval process; a reachable contact email is required for reviewer questions
Public apps get a public listing page visible to users and search crawlers
preparation: Working integration app with OAuth flow implemented
Listing assets: app name, description, icons, category, support/legal info
workflow: Sign up for a developer sandbox account
In the sandbox: Settings > (company name) Developer Hub
Click 'Create an app' > 'Create public app'; fill the registration form
Click 'Install & test' to verify the app in the sandbox
Preview the listing page via the Preview button in Developer Hub
Click 'Send to review'; answer reviewer questions via email
On approval, the app is UNLISTED by default — click '...' next to the app name and 'Publish' to go live
watchFor: Approved does not mean live — you must manually hit Publish after approval
Private apps never reach the Marketplace (they install via unlisted link) — choose 'public app'
Reviewer questions go to the app's main contact email — monitor it
Onboarding-guide edits post-approval don't need re-review, but app changes may
Listing quality (grammar, technical correctness, working flows) is part of review criteria
countsAsLive: The app has a public listing page at pipedrive.com/en/marketplace/app/<slug>/<id> visible without login
unknowns: Review turnaround time — not stated in public docs
Whether paid-via-Pipedrive billing is supported or listings always link out
